title: Run a shared check
summary: Flask: Run a shared check. Visit a route outside that prefix.
introduction: before_request runs before route handlers. This practice check rejects paths under /closed. Visit GET /closed/books.
learningObjectives: Run a shared check with Flask
Visit a route outside that prefix

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Run a shared check

blocks.text: The hook sees the /closed/ prefix and returns a response. The later view is not called.
Visit a route outside that prefix.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Returning a response stops the request from reaching its view.
